value.summary: FreshRoute wants a grocery-delivery dispatch platform with back-office order and fleet management, live courier tracking, ERP and maps integrations, customer notifications, courier proof-of-delivery screens, KPI reporting, historical spreadsheet import, and GDPR compliance for courier location data.

requirements.text: Provide a back-office admin interface to manage orders, couriers, and vans.
Provide a dispatcher dashboard that displays courier positions on a live map.
Integrate with Microsoft Dynamics to import orders and synchronize delivery status.
Integrate with a mapping service to support routing and estimated arrival times.
Send customer notifications by SMS and email.
Provide courier mobile app screens that support proof-of-delivery photos.
Provide a KPI reporting dashboard and Excel export.
Support importing historical orders from spreadsheets.
Meet GDPR requirements for courier location data.

ambiguities: The brief does not define the detailed workflows, fields, permissions, or lifecycle rules for managing orders, couriers, and vans.
The meaning and required update frequency of “live” courier positions are unspecified.
The Microsoft Dynamics product/version, integration method, data mappings, and synchronization frequency are unspecified.
The mapping provider and routing/ETA behavior are unspecified.
Notification triggers, templates, languages, and delivery-provider choices are unspecified.
The courier app platform and whether it must work offline are unspecified.
KPI definitions, filters, reporting periods, and Excel export format are unspecified.
Spreadsheet formats, validation rules, and expected historical data volume are unspecified.
The specific GDPR controls and retention periods for courier location data are unspecified.
Google Workspace single sign-on is described as a possible later feature, not a confirmed requirement.
assumptions: The requested courier mobile app screens are part of the platform scope, but the brief does not establish whether a new native app or an existing app is intended.
The ERP integration covers order import and delivery-status synchronization only, as explicitly stated.
The maps integration is intended to provide routing and ETAs, without assuming a particular provider.
Google Workspace single sign-on is not included in the confirmed initial scope.
risks: Dynamics integration effort may vary substantially depending on the client’s Dynamics version, available APIs, access, and data quality.
Live location tracking and GDPR obligations may require additional consent, access controls, retention policies, and auditability.
Third-party maps and messaging services may introduce usage costs, rate limits, or regional coverage constraints.
Unspecified operational workflows and KPI definitions may cause scope changes after discovery.
Historical spreadsheet data may require significant cleansing or transformation before import.
out_of_scope: Google Workspace single sign-on, unless separately confirmed for the initial release.
Features beyond the stated ERP integration scope of importing orders and synchronizing delivery status.
Any specific native-app implementation, offline capability, or additional courier-app functionality not stated in the brief.

unknowns.question: Is Google Workspace single sign-on required in the initial release?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The brief says it may be needed later. If required now, identity-provider integration and associated authentication and testing work must be added.

unknowns.question: Does the client require a new native courier mobile app, rather than screens in an existing app or a mobile web experience?
unknowns.why_it_matters: A new native app can require platform-specific implementation, packaging, device testing, and release work beyond implementing the stated screens.

scenario_if_yes.title: Build and package native courier app
Test courier app across target devices

unknowns.question: Must courier location tracking continue when the app is in the background or the device is offline?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Background and offline tracking can require additional mobile platform handling, location buffering, synchronization, and device testing.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement background and offline location capture and synchronization
Implement location buffering and synchronization services
Test background and offline tracking scenarios

unknowns.question: Does the client require a formal GDPR compliance package for location data, such as a DPIA, audit evidence, or specific retention and deletion workflows?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Formal compliance deliverables and specialized privacy controls can add analysis, implementation, and verification beyond baseline privacy safeguards.

scenario_if_yes.title: Define location-data privacy controls and compliance evidence
Prepare privacy impact and compliance documentation
